quote_required.scope: Premises or host alternatives, measured usable areas, use approval, access, parking, landlord works, rent review and outgoings.
Measured layout, acoustic design, building/fire/access review and certification fees.
Measured linear metres, wall height, door schedule, acoustic/fire performance, floor finish area, materials and installed labour.
Occupancy and heat-load design, duct routes, fresh air, plant scope and installed electrical work.
Confirmed points/circuits, distribution, testing, data cabling and controls.
Room concepts and quantities to compare, independent play without hints, local story permissions, access versions, playtests, manuals and content rights. No catalogue or number of scenarios selected.
Written configuration price, currency basis, packing, freight, customs/import GST, inland delivery and installation boundaries.
Recorded play with clear recording opt-out; capture, participant count, site RF/acoustics, review workload, storage, retention and acceptance tests.
Defined research and computation tasks, booking integration, usage, hosting, storage, testing and maintenance.
Legal/accounting service scope, public liability, property/contents, business interruption, cyber cover, workers compensation, applicable payroll tax and licences.
Luke remuneration allocation, venue manager duties/hours, specialist facilitation, breaks, child/access support, leave/relief and roster minimum-engagement effects.
Measured per-session cleaning/mic hygiene, printing, broken prop replacement, laundry and waste; quantity×actual supplier unit price.
Alternative utilities and connectivity tariffs, measured loads, hours, water, waste, cleaning and maintenance scope.
Actual referral agreements, portal fees, advertising quantities/rates, pass settlement administration and refunds.
Collection/delivery, repair, cleaning, assembly, anchoring, remaining service life, end-of-lease removal and waste charges.
Itemised risk register priced after scope/quotes; loan terms, fees, cash timing and tax. No invented flat percentage substituted for unresolved scope.

formulas.available_sessions: rooms × locations × starts_per_room_day × trading_days − blocked_room_days × starts_per_room_day
formulas.room_start_limit: floor((room_window_minutes − play_minutes) ÷ cycle_minutes) + 1, if window ≥ play; otherwise zero
formulas.delivered_cost: quantity × unit_price + freight + repair_cleaning + installation; eligible input GST deducted separately

rounding.money: Cash processor fee rounded to cents per payment before aggregation. Other internal arithmetic remains unrounded; money displayed to cents.
rounding.counts: Fractional expected annual sessions/visits are averages, not booked whole groups.
